### Sad Day
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-august-24-2024.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 11:14-15
Points:
- Israel joyfully celebrated at Gilgal when Saul was confirmed as king following his military success.
- From God's perspective, this was a tragic day because His people had rejected Him in favor of an earthly figurehead.
- This public coronation represented the peak of Saul's life before pride and jealousy unraveled his reign.
- True and lasting leadership requires modesty and reliance on the Lord rather than chasing the limelight.

### Saul’s Initial Success
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/sauls-initial-success
Passage: 1 Samuel 11:15
Points:
- Although Israel desired a king for flawed reasons, God empowered Saul by His Spirit to defeat the Ammonites.
- The people gathered at Gilgal in worship, offering peace sacrifices and joyfully confirming Saul's kingship before the Lord.
- Saul's initial triumph demonstrated how much God's people can accomplish when united under an obedient leader.
- The kingdom of God ultimately advances when believers unite in truth and submit to the leadership of Christ.
